fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-07-17 states that a maroon auto bearing registration number TN-28-ZZ-1080 used by Uma Raj for daily work was taken from Oviya Colony Railway Station Road, on 2025-07-17 at about 04:30. Deepak Subramani (9000000011) reported the matter for Uma Raj, whose contact number is given as 9000000089. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away after being left unattended.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, railway station road, early morning, auto, CCTV
